title: NSW to Align with EU Customs Requirements
author: NSW Team
excerpt: The National Single Window project will ensure full alignment with EU customs requirements, supporting Albania's EU accession process.
content: The National Single Window (NSW) project team announced on April 22, 2025, that the system will be designed in full alignment with European Union customs requirements. This strategic decision reflects Albania's commitment to accelerating the EU accession process and harmonizing national legislation with the acquis communautaire.

Alignment with EU standards encompasses several key aspects: adopting the Union Customs Code as a reference for digitalized processes, harmonizing the combined nomenclature for goods classification, and implementing a risk management system based on the EU model.

The Ministry of Economy and Innovation emphasized that this strategic orientation will deliver dual benefits: on one hand, it will facilitate cross-border trade with EU countries immediately, and on the other hand, it will prepare the digital infrastructure for full integration following accession.

European Commission experts have expressed readiness to provide technical assistance in the harmonization process, including sharing experiences with other countries in the region that have successfully implemented similar systems. This collaboration will ensure that the Albanian NSW meets the highest European best practices.
The EU harmonization plan will be integrated into the system's technical architecture and will be part of the evaluation criteria throughout all phases of project development.
